checks.detail:
turn 1: "Bar and Glow also both start at 0 s, if you'd rather stagger layers.

A few layers are left out:

- You've hidden Old Take, so I'll skip it unless you want it.

rubric.reason: Turn 1 names the group in one sentence with real names and times ("Title's Position, Scale and Opacity all run from 0.5 s to 1.5 s"), offers the other kind in one sentence ("Bar and Glow also both start at 0 s, if you'd rather stagger layers"), and lets the learner choose.

Turn 1 covers all four listed reasons with one short sentence each: CTRL ("is a null"), Old Take ("You've hidden"), Icon ("is a precomp, and I can't check its timing yet") and Logo ("An expression drives Logo's Rotation").

Turn 2 ends with "Which of the three should go first? How far apart do you want them?", leaving both as the learner's call without suggesting an order or gap; the learner has not answered yet, so no say-back is due.

Every layer, property and time mentioned appears in the offset_snapshot or preview_frame results, and "At 1 s all three are halfway through their moves" follows directly from the 0.5 s to 1.5 s range.

Turn 1 presents the group, other kind and leave-outs as one choice and ends on "Do you want to stagger Title's properties, or Bar and Glow?"; Turn 2 gives the confirmation, one frame clause and one sentence of idea ("When everything moves at once, nothing leads the eye"), then ends on the intent question.
